votes.plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Main Street Parity Act (H R 5763)
votes.bill_title: Main Street Parity Act
votes.plain_language: This bill lessens the financing requirements for certain Small Business Administration loans to small businesses for plant acquisition, construction, conversion, or expansion, including the acquisition of land. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

I was horrified by today’s building collapse in Flatbush. My heart is with the victims, their families, and everyone affected by this tragedy.

I am praying for their safety and grateful to the brave first responders working tirelessly to save lives.

This Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women in New York and across the US who have served our nation and the sacrifices they have made.

Today and every day, we must stand up for our veterans and ensure they receive the care, benefits, and support they have earned. https://t.co/hNVYzUAe8E

I was so proud to be included in @TIME's 100 most influential leaders on climate for 2026!

It's exciting to see NYC making progress on plant-based milk in schools. I'm proud to have championed this effort & hope to see more students benefit from climate-friendly choices. https://t.co/CWl3Nq4Fyg

Today in Puerto Rico, I stood with immigrant communities on the island who have endured months of terror at the hands of ICE.

Our immigrant neighbors are part of the fabric of this island. They deserve dignity.

ICE is beyond reform. It must be abolished. https://t.co/Bpe7W7pdlx

I strongly condemn the antisemitic, graffiti discovered on Jewish community school buses. This hateful act has no place in our community or anywhere in our society. Every child deserves to feel safe regardless of their faith or identity. Those responsible must be held accountable. We must stand united against antisemitism and all forms of hate .Thank you to the 90th precinct for investigating this matter.

I'm horrified by the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon. My heart breaks for the victims and their families and loved ones.

We cannot allow our nation's children to continue having their futures stolen by gun violence. Congress must act to end this epidemic.

Every day that ICE thugs roam our streets, innocent lives are put at risk.  

A child was reportedly in the car when ICE agents opened fire today in Marble Hill.  

We are still learning the details of this shooting, but it's clear that ICE has no place in our communities. ABOLISH ICE.

Three years ago, Hamas killed 1,200 people, including 43 Americans, and took hundreds hostage in a horrific act of terrorism. Today, we remember the lives stolen, the families broken apart, and the survivors who continue to live with that pain every day.

We must also continue fighting the global scourge of antisemitism wherever it takes root.

In the three years since October 7, more than 74,000 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza. We cannot look away from the genocide and immense human suffering inflicted on the Palestinian people.

We mourn every innocent life lost and recommit ourselves to a future where Israelis and Palestinians can live in peace, freedom, dignity, and security.

Sending people to countries where they have no ties and may face torture or other human rights abuses is barbaric.

The Trump administration must end its cruel third-country deportation policy and respect basic human rights. https://t.co/l0ZRifgzIr

I’m heartbroken by the loss of Leighton Brown, a  NYCHA worker killed during Saturday’s storm.

He was known at Cypress Hills as someone who always showed up and helped his neighbors. I'm thinking of his family, coworkers, and all those mourning his loss.
https://t.co/7mxSrjL2TQ

Proud to join lawmakers from 13 countries across the Western Hemisphere in calling for an end to these barbaric strikes in the Caribbean and Pacific.

More than 200 people have been killed. There must be accountability, and these attacks must end.

https://t.co/zvFiWu9Rin

Wishing a meaningful Yom Kippur to all who are observing in New York City and around the world. 

May this be a time of reflection, prayer, and renewal. G’mar Chatima Tovah.

Nine years ago today, Hurricane María made landfall near my hometown of Yabucoa. Thousands of lives were lost, and Puerto Rico was forever changed.

Nine years later, the island has still not fully recovered. Today, we remember those we lost and recommit ourselves to the work of building a stronger, more resilient Puerto Rico.

Honored to receive CHCI’s Lifetime Achievement Award last night alongside so many friends, colleagues and members of my CHC family.

We’ve come a long way in building Latino political power, and I know the next generation is ready to carry that work forward.

¡Pa’lante, siempre! https://t.co/SYLSijalE4

Wishing a happy, healthy, and sweet New Year to the Jewish community in NY-07 and around the world. 

I wish you a year of peace, justice, and renewal. Shanah Tovah!

As any New Yorker will tell you, 9/11 is ingrained into our lives forever. We remember where we were that morning and the shock and grief will never fully go away.

Twenty-five years later, we remember the nearly 3,000 innocent people whose lives were stolen. Each one was someone's father, mother, brother, sister, spouse, or child. Many were our neighbors in Brooklyn and Queens.

We remember the first responders who rushed into those buildings to save others, many of whom made the ultimate sacrifice. And we remember that our obligation to them did not end that day. Honoring them with words alone has never been enough.

In the face of unimaginable tragedy, New Yorkers came together. We comforted one another, we helped strangers, and we rebuilt. That spirit is what carried us through, and it must guide us still.

We will never forget.

I will never forget Gloria Steinem's endorsement during my first campaign for Congress.

She was a trailblazer who saw what women could be before the country did. As others try to pull women's rights backward, we will carry her spirit forward. Rest in power. https://t.co/J4xQE9m1QL

Pierre Damas Bel was 20 years old, an honors student with plans for medical school. He did everything right. This administration took his TPS anyway and ICE put a monitor on his ankle. 

He was humiliated and bullied for it. Now he is dead. This is what these policies cost. My prayers are with his family.

The Trump administration told us they were going after the "worst of the worst."

That was a lie.

More than 3 in 4 people ICE arrested in New York City last month had no criminal record. This makes no one safer. It only rips apart lives and families.
https://t.co/uytL2nnCSO

If you are trying to reach someone:

Looking for family in Nepal: 1-888-407-4747 from the US or Canada.
Looking for family in China: 011-86-10-8531 4000 from the US.

My heart breaks for the victims of the flooding along the Nepal-Tibet border, and for the New Yorkers waiting on word about family half a world away. 

To our Nepali and Tibetan neighbors you are not in this alone. My office is here to assist.

https://t.co/glkI8cqCeY

We all saw what happened at Delaney Hall. @RepLaMonica was doing her job trying to conduct oversight of the terrible conditions there.

Criminalizing oversight is how authoritarians operate. Every member of Congress should be alarmed.

I stand with Rep. McIver. https://t.co/al2VfP7nxL

In six days, Culebra loses the operator of its only health center. No one has explained why, and the search for a replacement doesn't close until September 23. That gap threatens to disrupt care at the center for months.

I'm demanding answers from the Puerto Rico Department of Health before August 31.

Donald Trump votes by mail. He just doesn't want you to.

This order has nothing to do with election security and everything to do with stopping people from voting. And this extreme MAGA Supreme Court is letting him do it. https://t.co/534UzZWg6l

El Gobierno de Puerto Rico ha decidido alterar de forma abrupta la administración del único centro que ofrece servicios hospitalarios en Culebra.

Este cambio pone en riesgo la calidad actual de los servicios, afectando al personal, las licencias del centro y su infraestructura, que está conectada a dos farmacias que Culebra no tenía antes de que se creara esta instalación.

Los puertorriqueños merecen transparencia y respuestas sobre la razón de esta transición, cuando por primera vez la isla municipio contaba con un CDT funcional. Arriesgarse a que Culebra se quede sin servicios de salud de calidad no puede ser una opción.

For decades Chino García was there for every fight on  the Lower East Side: for tenants, for artists, for Puerto Rican families fighting displacement. I was proud to stand with him. 

He believed the LES could build its own future, and he proved it. RIP. 
https://t.co/7OcR0DhpR6
